name: streamlink-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Streamlink, a command-line utility and Python library that extracts streams from
streaming services. Its library resolves URLs to plugins through a session with configurable options, lets
plugins match URLs, declare arguments and return named streams, sorts and names stream qualities, parses HLS
playlists and DASH manifests into HLS, DASH, HTTP and muxed streams, caches plugin data, validates parsed data
with a schema API, and provides parsing, URL, time, localization and argument helpers.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the streamlink Python library under src/streamlink/ except the site plugins in src/streamlink/plugins/ and the browser automation in src/streamlink/webbrowser/ and src/streamlink/plugin/api/webbrowser/, together with docs/api_guide.rst, docs/api_guide/quickstart.rst, docs/api_guide/validate.rst, docs/api.rst, docs/api/streamlink.rst, docs/api/session.rst, docs/api/plugin.rst, docs/api/options.rst, docs/api/cache.rst, docs/api/validate.rst, docs/api/stream.rst, docs/api/exceptions.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
